scope: Six authorized interface usability corrections; no new physics, provider policy or spending approval.

python.skip_reason: Docker unavailable on this Windows environment

checks: Guided review opens and closes in place from Projects, work-area hubs, Overview and Systems without hidden navigation or provider calls
Calculate and Recalculate each save a new review on an already calculated revision, show progress/completion and prevent duplicate in-flight starts
The companion draws actual local WebGL geometry rather than the previous SVG, with frames rendered before interaction
Pointer dragging repositions without opening AI, restores its saved position after reload, and retains normal click and keyboard repositioning
Reduced motion pauses the rocket animation without removing its functional launcher
Nemotron keeps the primary question/model/start controls and all three models, makes no selection-triggered call, and preserves a completed evidence-backed answer
Tavily starts with a small duplicate-free human-readable list, while Advanced preserves exact finding/assumption targets without starting a search
The spaced Source library explains missing form fields, receives an unsaved Tavily preview, and saves/links only through two separate explicit actions
Project names, source text, native controls and Nemotron dialog copy share the global UI font rather than local module-specific stacks
Dragged companion and simplified conversation remain inside a narrow mobile viewport with no page-wide horizontal overflow
Simplified hosted conversation preserves the existing owner-only controls and financial-status boundary
Only explicit isolated actions posted; original design, numerical results and allowance remain unchanged, with no external provider traffic
Graphics-context loss exposes the honest local fallback while the draggable assistant remains functional
Requirement Assistant offers Nano, Super and Ultra; retained records name their actual models
Choosing every model retains the question and history, updates consent, and makes no POST or provider request
Changing investigation scope while a requirement job runs retains the global busy guard without another POST
Explicit requirement start reaches Ultra; switching is disabled while running and never creates a second request
A new chosen-model job does not rewrite historical Nano, Super or Ultra receipts
Whole-project Assistant retains all choices and sends the explicitly selected Nano with project scope
Assistant body and helper type meet readable sizes; mobile fields are at least sixteen pixels without page overflow
Shared synthetic allowance is preserved, canonical engineering unchanged, and only the two explicit investigation POSTs occur
Overview explains all three result meanings and the main journey while preserving engineering values
Review report retains quantitative criteria and unassessed scope without changing their meaning
Normal requirement investigation keeps all models and history without visible financial accounting
Whole-project investigation also keeps owner accounting out of the working view
Detailed connection and spend controls remain available in the explicit owner surface
Clicking outside owner connection dialog dismisses it and clears the unsaved key field
Dynamically created Tavily settings dismiss outside, destroy the private field and reopen empty without connecting
Outside, close-button and Escape dismissal preserve edited project-form entries when declined; explicit discard closes the form
Clear overview and result explanations fit a narrow mobile viewport
Protected visitor session has financial-status redaction and cannot execute or read owner administrative diagnostics
Navigation/settings made no inference/search/upload/save calls and left the owner fixture unchanged
Selected project and saved revision have an addressable overview
Five broad work areas are reachable without a flat list of every tool
Native browser Back and Forward restore internal locations
Reload preserves the routed project, saved revision and work area
A deep link to a historical revision survives reload
System Table, selected requirement and evidence panel survive deep reload with a parent breadcrumb
Same-project page navigation and Back retain the unsaved shared draft without a database write
Cancelled project switch preserves draft; confirmed switch explicitly discards it
Cancelling browser Back across project context preserves URL, displayed project and draft
Accepting browser Back loads the previous saved project and discards only the unsaved draft
Back during a delayed project load leaves URL and displayed project in the same context
Unapplied stage-profile values survive blocked area, project and revision navigation
Browser Back cannot remount or discard an unapplied stage-profile form
Explicit profile cancellation restores navigation while saved staged inputs stay unchanged
Requested local editorial typography, ink and soft canvas are applied without remote fonts
Navigation layout stays within a narrow viewport
Original fixture receipts unchanged; no provider, search, upload, calculation or save POSTs; no browser errors

visual_acceptance: Procedural metallic WebGL geometry, animated exhaust and bounded fallback inspected locally; final visual preference remains subject to founder review.
